headline: This law directs congressional leaders to arrange a Congressional Gold Medal for members of the World War II Office of Strategic Services.
what_it_does: The law requires the Speaker of the House and the President pro tempore of the Senate to arrange for a Congressional Gold Medal to be presented to members of the Office of Strategic Services for their World War II service. After the medal is awarded, it must be given to the Smithsonian Institution.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 14, 2016. The summary does not give a date for the medal presentation.
